author: Krono I
title: Dilated CNN Backbone (Dilation=6) - Final Test
abstract: This is the final experiment in my series investigating dilated convolutions. Following the success of dilation rates 2, 3, 4, and 5 (which scored 72.0), this experiment increases the rate to 6. The goal is to determine the peak of the performance curve for this architectural modification and to provide a definitive conclusion for my research on this topic.
